dataList.content: Annette Sang Pengubah's Perisai breaks when she becomes Staggered. Try using Tremor Identities or Identities that hit multiple times to break through Annette's Perisai more efficiently.
Defending may be safer than attacking when Annette uses her special Skill against an Alteration Target.
Keep SP under control to avoid entering Panic.
Make good use of allies that have Laurel Wreath of Atonement.
The Pengawas consumes its own HP whenever it summons a Tahanan Disamak.
Disobeying the Pengawas's prohibitions causes it to retaliate with a powerful attack.
Distribute "Apocalyptic Vengeance" Stacks across your allies instead of letting them pile up on one unit. Used well, they can greatly reduce damage from certain Skills.
Winning a Clash against the Le Noir Brand Manager's "Covenant" Skill can greatly reduce the Perisai it gains from "Revelation".

If you are hit by the "Pick stitch too obvious, you say?! I'll pick-stitch your ass!" Skill while you have accumulated many stacks of Naildle, you will enter the "Taxidermized" state and receive devastating damage.
If there are surviving Needlekins in the same turn as when the Raja Needleworks uses a powerful Skill, they will enhance that Skill's damage.

Sous Chef gains "Chopped Ingredients" from unit she kills. These are consumed at the end of the turn, granting her stacks of "Eat yummies and perk up, you hear?".

The more she gets the stacks, the stronger and more frequent will her powerful move, "My signature knife work, you hear?", become.
Leather Wallets are not an exception when it comes to Sous Chef's ingredient-gathering. You cannot stop her culinary activity by playing defensively.

When Sous Chef fails to kill any targets, she will get stacks of "Got an appetite, you hear?". At 3 stacks, she will use another powerful Skill. It may be a good idea to let her continue cooking every once in a while.
Sometimes, Clashing against the Manajer Lantai's certain skill with your Attack Skills could be a bad idea.

Be too wary and let yourself accumulate 10 stacks of "Guarded Caution", and you will risk inviting the Manajer Lantai's powerful Skill.
Pay attention so that "Guarded Caution" does not reach 10 stacks. You may also choose to lose a Clash against a certain Skill to remove the stacks.
If you have "Gratitude for Listening", perhaps you will want to stay your attacks for a short while.

Higher Stacks of "Tangling" increase damage taken and lowers Power. At 15+ Stacks, certain Skills can force Stagger on hit. Use Defense Skills or Clash against "Cleansing" to keep "Tangling" under control.
"Pool of Black Water" is lost only sekali per Skill when hit. Skills with high Atk Weight are the most efficient way to remove it in one go.

"Abyssal Maw," Benang Hitam dari Laut Elden's Skill, deals near-lethal damage if the target is Staggered or has 20+ "Tangling". It can be Clashed against regardless of Speed, so keep "Tangling" Stacks below 20 and always intercept it when a Pendosa is at risk.
Keeping Putty's Speed under control is key to this fight.
Manage Charge Count carefully so that Coins do not become Unbreakable.
